rules.name: no-restricted-globals
rules.description: Disallow specified global variables

rules.name: no-restricted-imports
rules.description: Disallow specified modules when loaded by `import`

rules.name: no-restricted-properties
rules.description: Disallow certain properties on certain objects

rules.name: no-restricted-syntax
rules.description: Disallow specified syntax

rules.name: no-return-assign
rules.description: Disallow assignment operators in `return` statements

rules.name: no-script-url
rules.description: Disallow `javascript:` URLs

rules.name: no-sequences
rules.description: Disallow comma operators

rules.name: no-shadow
rules.description: Disallow variable declarations from shadowing variables declared in the outer scope

rules.name: no-shadow-restricted-names
rules.description: Disallow identifiers from shadowing restricted names

rules.name: no-ternary
rules.description: Disallow ternary operators

rules.name: no-throw-literal
rules.description: Disallow throwing literals as exceptions

rules.name: no-undef-init
rules.description: Disallow initializing variables to `undefined`

rules.name: no-undefined
rules.description: Disallow the use of `undefined` as an identifier

rules.name: no-underscore-dangle
rules.description: Disallow dangling underscores in identifiers

rules.name: no-unneeded-ternary
rules.description: Disallow ternary operators when simpler alternatives exist

rules.name: no-unused-expressions
rules.description: Disallow unused expressions

rules.name: no-unused-labels
rules.description: Disallow unused labels

rules.name: no-useless-call
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary calls to `.call()` and `.apply()`

rules.name: no-useless-catch
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary `catch` clauses

rules.name: no-useless-computed-key
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary computed property keys in objects and classes

rules.name: no-useless-concat
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary concatenation of literals or template literals

rules.name: no-useless-constructor
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary constructors

rules.name: no-useless-escape
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary escape characters

rules.name: no-useless-rename
rules.description: Disallow renaming import, export, and destructured assignments to the same name

rules.name: no-useless-return
rules.description: Disallow redundant return statements

rules.name: no-var
rules.description: Require `let` or `const` instead of `var`

rules.name: no-void
rules.description: Disallow `void` operators

rules.name: no-warning-comments
rules.description: Disallow specified warning terms in comments

rules.name: no-with
rules.description: Disallow `with` statements

rules.name: object-shorthand
rules.description: Require or disallow method and property shorthand syntax for object literals

rules.name: one-var
rules.description: Enforce variables to be declared either together or separately in functions

rules.name: operator-assignment
rules.description: Require or disallow assignment operator shorthand where possible

rules.name: prefer-arrow-callback
rules.description: Require using arrow functions for callbacks

rules.name: prefer-const
rules.description: Require `const` declarations for variables that are never reassigned after declared

rules.name: prefer-destructuring
rules.description: Require destructuring from arrays and/or objects

rules.name: prefer-exponentiation-operator
rules.description: Disallow the use of `Math.pow` in favor of the `**` operator

rules.name: prefer-named-capture-group
rules.description: Enforce using named capture group in regular expression

rules.name: prefer-numeric-literals
rules.description: Disallow `parseInt()` and `Number.parseInt()` in favor of binary, octal, and hexadecimal literals

rules.name: prefer-object-has-own
rules.description: Disallow use of `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call()` and prefer use of `Object.hasOwn()`

rules.name: prefer-object-spread
rules.description: Disallow using `Object.assign` with an object literal as the first argument and prefer the use of object spread instead

rules.name: prefer-promise-reject-errors
rules.description: Require using Error objects as Promise rejection reasons

rules.name: prefer-regex-literals
rules.description: Disallow use of the `RegExp` constructor in favor of regular expression literals

rules.name: prefer-rest-params
rules.description: Require rest parameters instead of `arguments`

rules.name: prefer-spread
rules.description: Require spread operators instead of `.apply()`

rules.name: prefer-template
rules.description: Require template literals instead of string concatenation

rules.name: preserve-caught-error
rules.description: Disallow losing originally caught error when re-throwing custom errors

rules.name: radix
rules.description: Enforce the consistent use of the radix argument when using `parseInt()`

rules.name: react/checked-requires-onchange-or-readonly
rules.description: Enforce using `onChange` or `readonly` attribute when `checked` is used

rules.name: react/display-name
rules.description: Disallow missing displayName in a React component definition

rules.name: react/forbid-dom-props
rules.description: Disallow certain props on DOM Nodes

rules.name: react/jsx-filename-extension
rules.description: Disallow file extensions that may contain JSX

rules.name: react/jsx-key
rules.description: Disallow missing `key` props in iterators/collection literals

rules.name: react/jsx-uses-vars
rules.description: Disallow variables used in JSX to be incorrectly marked as unused

rules.name: react/no-children-prop
rules.description: Disallow passing of children as props

rules.name: react/no-find-dom-node
rules.description: Disallow usage of findDOMNode

rules.name: react/no-is-mounted
rules.description: Disallow usage of isMounted

rules.name: react/no-multi-comp
rules.description: Disallow multiple component definition per file

rules.name: react/no-redundant-should-component-update
rules.description: Disallow usage of shouldComponentUpdate when extending React.PureComponent

rules.name: react/no-render-return-value
rules.description: Disallow usage of the return value of ReactDOM.render

rules.name: react/no-string-refs
rules.description: Disallow using string references

rules.name: react/prefer-es6-class
rules.description: Enforce ES5 or ES6 class for React Components

rules.name: react/prefer-read-only-props
rules.description: Enforce that props are read-only

rules.name: react/prefer-stateless-function
rules.description: Enforce stateless components to be written as a pure function

rules.name: react/prop-types
rules.description: Disallow missing props validation in a React component definition

rules.name: react/style-prop-object
rules.description: Enforce style prop value is an object

rules.name: require-await
rules.description: Disallow async functions which have no `await` expression

rules.name: require-unicode-regexp
rules.description: Enforce the use of `u` or `v` flag on regular expressions

rules.name: require-yield
rules.description: Require generator functions to contain `yield`

rules.name: sort-imports
rules.description: Enforce sorted `import` declarations within modules

rules.name: sort-keys
rules.description: Require object keys to be sorted

rules.name: sort-vars
rules.description: Require variables within the same declaration block to be sorted

rules.name: strict
rules.description: Require or disallow strict mode directives

rules.name: symbol-description
rules.description: Require symbol descriptions

rules.name: vars-on-top
rules.description: Require `var` declarations be placed at the top of their containing scope

rules.name: yoda
rules.description: Require or disallow "Yoda" conditions

rules.name: ApexAssertionsShouldIncludeMessage
rules.description: The second parameter of System.assert/third parameter of System.assertEquals/System.assertNotEquals is a message. Having a second/third parameter provides more information and makes it easier to debug the test failure and improves the readability of test output.

rules.name: ApexUnitTestClassShouldHaveAsserts
rules.description: Apex unit tests should include at least one assertion. This makes the tests more robust, and using assert with messages provide the developer a clearer idea of what the test does. Custom assert method invocation patterns can be specified using the 'additionalAssertMethodPattern' property if required.

rules.name: ApexUnitTestClassShouldHaveRunAs
rules.description: Apex unit tests should include at least one runAs method. This makes the tests more robust, and independent from the user running it.

rules.name: ApexUnitTestMethodShouldHaveIsTestAnnotation
rules.description: Apex test methods should have `@isTest` annotation instead of the `testMethod` keyword, as `testMethod` is deprecated. Salesforce advises to use @isTest annotation for test classes and methods.

rules.name: ApexUnitTestShouldNotUseSeeAllDataTrue
rules.description: Apex unit tests should not use @isTest(seeAllData=true) because it opens up the existing database data for unexpected modification by tests.

rules.name: AvoidFutureAnnotation
rules.description: Usage of the `@Future` annotation should be limited. The `@Future` annotation is a legacy way to execute asynchronous Apex code, but it has several limitations: - Methods must be static - Only primitive data types, primitive arrays, or collections of primitive data types can be parameters - No way to monitor job status or handle failures - No support for chaining jobs Consider... Learn more: https://docs.pmd-code.org/pmd-doc-7.26.0/pmd_rules_apex_bestpractices.html#avoidfutureannotation

rules.name: AvoidGlobalModifier
rules.description: Global classes should be avoided (especially in managed packages) as they can never be deleted or changed in signature. Always check twice if something needs to be global. Many interfaces (e.g. Batch) required global modifiers in the past but don't require this anymore. Don't lock yourself in.

rules.name: AvoidInlineStyles
rules.description: Don't mix content and style. Use separate CSS-files for the style and introduce classes. This helps to reuse common styles.

rules.name: AvoidLogicInTrigger
rules.description: As triggers do not allow methods like regular classes they are less flexible and suited to apply good encapsulation style. Therefore delegate the triggers work to a regular class (often called Trigger handler class). See more here: <https://developer.salesforce.com/page/Trigger_Frameworks_and_Apex_Trigger_Best_Practices>

rules.name: AvoidWithStatement
rules.description: Avoid using with - it's bad news

rules.name: ConsistentReturn
rules.description: ECMAScript does provide for return types on functions, and therefore there is no solid rule as to their usage. However, when a function does use returns they should all have a value, or all with no value. Mixed return usage is likely a bug, or at best poor style.

rules.name: DebugsShouldUseLoggingLevel
rules.description: The first parameter of System.debug, when using the signature with two parameters, is a LoggingLevel enum. Having the Logging Level specified provides a cleaner log, and improves readability of it.

rules.name: GlobalVariable
rules.description: This rule helps to avoid using accidentally global variables by simply missing the "var" declaration. Global variables can lead to side-effects that are hard to debug.

rules.name: MissingEncoding
rules.description: When the character encoding is missing from the XML declaration, the parser may produce garbled text. This is completely dependent on how the parser is set up and the content of the XML file, so it may be hard to reproduce. Providing an explicit encoding ensures accurate and consistent parsing.

rules.name: QueueableWithoutFinalizer
rules.description: Detects when the Queueable interface is used but a Finalizer is not attached. It is best practice to call the `System.attachFinalizer(Finalizer f)` method within the `execute` method of a class which implements the `Queueable` interface. Without attaching a Finalizer, there is no way of designing error recovery actions should the Queueable action fail.

rules.name: ScopeForInVariable
rules.description: A for-in loop in which the variable name is not explicitly scoped to the enclosing scope with the 'var' keyword can refer to a variable in an enclosing scope outside the nearest enclosing scope. This will overwrite the existing value of the variable in the outer scope when the body of the for-in is evaluated. When the for-in loop has finished, the variable will contain the last... Learn more: https://docs.pmd-code.org/pmd-doc-7.26.0/pmd_rules_ecmascript_bestpractices.html#scopeforinvariable

rules.name: UnnecessaryTypeAttribute
rules.description: In HTML5 the explicit type attribute for link and script elements is not needed. Modern browsers expect stylesheets to be in CSS and scripts to use JavaScript.

rules.name: UnusedLocalVariable
rules.description: Detects when a local variable is declared and/or assigned but not used.

rules.name: UseAltAttributeForImages
rules.description: Always use an "alt" attribute for images. This provides an alternative text and is extensively used by screen readers.

rules.name: UseBaseWithParseInt
rules.description: This rule checks for usages of parseInt. While the second parameter is optional and usually defaults to 10 (base/radix is 10 for a decimal number), different implementations may behave differently. It also improves readability, if the base is given. See also: parseInt()

rules.name: ApexCRUDViolation
rules.description: Validates that DML operations and SOQL queries are preceded by the appropriate CRUD permission checks (isCreateable, isUpdateable, isAccessible, isDeletable) or use WITH USER_MODE.

rules.name: ApexSOQLInjection
rules.description: Detects the usage of untrusted / unescaped variables in DML queries. Dynamic SOQL built from user-controlled input without bind variables or String.escapeSingleQuotes() is vulnerable to injection.

rules.name: AvoidDmlStatementsInLoops
rules.description: Detects DML statements (insert, update, upsert, delete, merge) placed inside loops. Each iteration consumes a DML governor limit; accumulate records and DML once outside the loop.

rules.name: AvoidSoqlInLoops
rules.description: Detects SOQL queries placed inside loops. Each iteration consumes a SOQL governor limit; collect IDs, query once outside the loop, then process results.

rules.name: ApexSharingViolations
rules.description: Detects Apex classes that do not explicitly declare a sharing model (with sharing, without sharing, or inherited sharing). Classes without an explicit declaration inherit the sharing of their caller, which can be unpredictable.

rules.name: AvoidHardcodingId
rules.description: Detects hardcoded 15- or 18-character Salesforce record IDs. IDs differ between orgs and sandboxes; use Custom Labels, Custom Metadata, or SOQL lookups instead.

rules.name: ApexDoc
rules.description: Validates that global and public Apex methods and classes have ApexDoc comments. Good documentation improves maintainability and is required before publishing in managed packages.

rules.name: OneDeclarationPerLine
rules.description: Apex allows the declaration of multiple variables on one line. This harms readability and should be avoided.
